# The Farm Media

> The Farm Media is a Springfield, Missouri contractor marketing agency that builds customer acquisition systems for local service businesses.

- [Contractor marketing services](https://marketwiththefarm.com/services/)
- [Contractor website design](https://marketwiththefarm.com/services/web-design/)

- [Facebook Ads management](https://marketwiththefarm.com/services/facebook-ads/)
- [CRM and lead automation](https://marketwiththefarm.com/services/crm-automation/)
